main_text.p: eius.Propterea cùm nihil cernimus, tum te-nebras à lumine difcernimus,fed non eodem modo. Sentiendi igitur duplex eft facultas propria vna,vt vifus, cuius proprium videre eft,auditus audire,guftatus guftare,odoratus olfacere,tactus tangere:altera communis, quæ prædictarum caufa eft.& cuius opera animal eius quod cernit vel audit fenfu efficitur.Nec etiâ dulcia ab albis difcernere poffumus nisi hac sentiendi facultate.Eft itēq; [?]caufa,cur animal id vifu percipiat,quod cernit,& dulcis ab amaris diftinguit. Hæc enim cuncta fiunt quadam communi parte, quæ vniuersa fouet senforiarum genera.Senfuum enim omnium vnus eft præcipuus, vt & vnum senforium. Cæterum dubitauerit quispiam & quæfiuerit qui fiat vt communis ille senfus diuerfa fimul senfilia difcernat,& in indiuiduo tempore, cùm fieri nequeat idem, quod indiuiduum eft,in diftincto tepore contrariis motionibus cieri. Sed hoc nihil mirari oportet, cùm vifus fimul & eodem tempore albu m & nigrum diftinguat & diiudicet, quamuis diuerfa fint.Propterea senfus communis fi mul nigrum & amarum, quæ nō aduerfa funt,discernere poteft.

page.notes: The first word "eius" is a fragment continuing the sentence from the previous page. The word after "ite" is a contracted abbreviation (probably itaque, printed with a superscript mark) that I could not read with certainty. "albu m" is a printed spacing error and is kept as printed. "senforiarum" and "senfuum" carry the printed spelling. A faint mark at the bottom centre is not text and is left out.
